_comment: What dataset_type training means: every entry type and the packaged augmentation section. The inputs' axes are log-weighted (inputs.axes_weighting), to spread training data more evenly over the axis values; the outputs keep the table's weights. Each input is answered twice (outputs.outputs_per_input), so a borderline input gets one answer of each mode. A recipe's stages replace these, its augmentations overlay these kind by kind, and its params file overlays these params key by key per stage.
